Standard: Controls can be fully actuated without range of travel restrictions by the intended anthropometric population under all operating conditions while wearing required crewmember equipment. Controls should be located IAW MIL-STD-203, Location of Controls paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground or Lab test: Conduct human-in-the-loop evaluation with a group of participants, representative of the range of anthropometric dimensions of the intended user population, to verify ability to operate controls through the full range of travel. This evaluation should be in a production representative mock-up or on the air vehicle with participants wearing required crewmember equipment. Measure clearances and reaches while participants are appropriately restrained based on the reach zone requirements of the controls at the extreme seat positions. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(2) Ground test: Verify the crew station or control station accommodation envelope by measuring the clearances and reaches on a group of participants, representative of the range of anthropometric dimensions of the intended user population, in a production representative air vehicle. Participants will wear required crewmember equipment. Measure clearances and reaches while participants are appropriately restrained based on the reach zone requirements of the controls at the extreme seat positions. Use measurements and participant body dimensions to determine the accommodation envelope of the air vehicle, the minimum and maximum anthropometric dimensions required to fly the air vehicle.
